title: The Gloria Tornado
subtitle: A memory from the backseat
quote: I’m dressed and watching Gloria tornado through the house — of course it’s stressful, everything always is, and of course we’re late.

captions.instagram:
“I’m dressed and watching Gloria tornado through the house — of course it’s stressful, everything always is, and of course we’re late.”

Blackberry bushes along a miles-long dirt road. My little brother buckled into his car seat beside me. My mom's things, and she always has so many things, thrown onto the passenger seat. And the one thing she forgot at the house.

From The Gloria Tornado, on Not Plain. Read it at the link in bio.
